notes.title: New game mode added & new card set DLC available!
notes.content:
New card set DLC - Fruits & Vegetables - get it for free
 New game mode - Chill - without the timer and scoring
 New option to show the current score while playing (eye icon)

notes.title: New Extreme difficulty added!
notes.content:
Extreme difficulty added with own leaderboard
 2 new achievements for the Extreme difficulty scores
 6 new cards for more variety
 Cards are now randomly selected from the whole pool

notes.title: Update v1.01
notes.content:
You can now see your leaderboard rank even if you are outside of the Top 10.
 Settings for Music and Sounds are now saved (in the cloud).
